commission: TRY FOREVER heartbeat 1700 non-phone source slice: separate optional heartbeat-light ingress rejection from independent heartbeat-sink invocation without hiding storage/runtime failures.

code_first_findings.finding: The first policy result called a normal heartbeat-sink return heartbeatAccepted. OperatorState.heartbeat uses SharedPreferences.apply(), so that name overstated source evidence as acceptance/durability.
code_first_findings.correction: Renamed the field to heartbeatInvoked and documented that a normal return is not synchronous disk durability, deployment, runtime observation, phone callability, delivery, or acceptance. Regression names and the DOM specimen were corrected to match.

code_first_findings.finding: Caller-invalid optional telemetry is isolated without swallowing internal/storage failures.
code_first_findings.evidence: HeartbeatIngressPolicy catches only IllegalArgumentException from the optional payload sink; IllegalStateException and heartbeat-sink failures propagate and return no success result.

OverlayUpdateReceiver still owns ACTION_HEARTBEAT and delegates to OperatorState; the new policy is pure ordering/error composition and owns no receiver registration, storage, renderer, queue, transport, phone body, or P0 recovery.

code_first_findings.finding: Regression source covers the materially distinct error classes and order contract.
code_first_findings.evidence: Fixtures cover blank optional payload, valid payload before heartbeat invocation, caller-invalid optional payload followed by heartbeat invocation, storage failure with no heartbeat invocation, and heartbeat-sink failure propagation.

code_first_findings.finding: Source art remains accessibility-oriented and non-raster without claiming runtime proof.
code_first_findings.evidence: The specimen uses native buttons, aria-pressed, visible focus, one live region, non-color tokens, reduced-motion handling, inline SVG/DOM only, and an explicit SOURCE ONLY / NOT OPERATOR-OVERLAY RUNTIME PROOF scar.
